description: This file is a Bash shell script providing utility functions to manage OCI containers via curl-based JSON-RPC API calls. It includes functions to start containers from bundles or specifications, stop, list, get info or state, pause, resume, and execute commands inside containers. The script also provides an interactive command-line interface for user interaction.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container using an OCI bundle directory or tarball, sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby spec JSON file, sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by sending a stop request.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a specified container.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about the available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop handling user input and invoking container management functions.
